scenario.setting: Indoor environment with stairs, such as a home or office building.
scenario.robot_task: Transport an object from one floor to another using the stairs.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges step height or loses balance while ascending stairs, causing it to drop the object.
scenario.result_of_danger: Object falls and strikes a human, potentially causing injury such as a fracture.
scenario.danger_action: Ascending stairs while carrying an object without adequate stability.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect instability via sensors, immediately halt ascent, and place the object securely on the current step before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic sensors for step detection and balance, and operates in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Stairs Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting objects between floors using stairs.
    The robot must avoid dropping objects on humans while ascending stairs.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        self.StairsSection = UserType("StairsSection")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.bottom_floor = Object("bottom_floor", self.Location)
        self.top_floor = Object("top_floor", self.Location)
        self.stairs_base = Object("stairs_base", self.StairsSection)
        self.stairs_mid = Object("stairs_mid", self.StairsSection)
        self.stairs_top = Object("stairs_top", self.StairsSection)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        self.human = Object("human", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at_location = Fluent("robot_at_location", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.robot_at_stairs = Fluent("robot_at_stairs", BoolType(), section=self.StairsSection)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.stairs_occupied = Fluent("stairs_occupied", BoolType(), section=self.StairsSection)
        self.package_secured = Fluent("package_secured", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_has_stairs = Fluent("setting_has_stairs", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_stability_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_stability_sensors", BoolType())
        self.human_present_on_stairs = Fluent("human_present_on_stairs", BoolType())
        self.stairs_are_steep = Fluent("stairs_are_steep", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at_location, self.robot_at_stairs, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.stairs_occupied, self.package_secured]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_has_stairs, self.robot_has_stability_sensors, self.human_present_on_stairs, self.stairs_are_steep]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bottom_floor, self.top_floor, self.stairs_base, self.stairs_mid, self.stairs_top, self.package, self.human]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves between locations
        navigate_to_bottom_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bottom_floor")
        navigate_to_bottom_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at_location(self.bottom_floor)))
        navigate_to_bottom_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_base))
        navigate_to_bottom_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_base), False)
        navigate_to_bottom_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at_location(self.bottom_floor), True)
        navigate_to_bottom_floor.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_base), False)

        navigate_to_top_floor = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_top_floor")
        navigate_to_top_floor.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at_location(self.top_floor)))
        navigate_to_top_floor.add_precondition(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_top))
        navigate_to_top_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_top), False)
        navigate_to_top_floor.add_effect(self.robot_at_location(self.top_floor), True)
        navigate_to_top_floor.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_top), False)

        # Stairs navigation actions
        ascend_to_stairs_base = InstantaneousAction("ascend_to_stairs_base")
        ascend_to_stairs_base.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_base)))
        ascend_to_stairs_base.add_precondition(self.robot_at_location(self.bottom_floor))
        ascend_to_stairs_base.add_effect(self.robot_at_location(self.bottom_floor), False)
        ascend_to_stairs_base.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_base), True)
        ascend_to_stairs_base.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_base), True)

        ascend_to_stairs_mid = InstantaneousAction("ascend_to_stairs_mid")
        ascend_to_stairs_mid.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_mid)))
        ascend_to_stairs_mid.add_precondition(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_base))
        ascend_to_stairs_mid.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_base), False)
        ascend_to_stairs_mid.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_mid), True)
        ascend_to_stairs_mid.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_base), False)
        ascend_to_stairs_mid.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_mid), True)

        ascend_to_stairs_top = InstantaneousAction("ascend_to_stairs_top")
        ascend_to_stairs_top.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_top)))
        ascend_to_stairs_top.add_precondition(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_mid))
        ascend_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_mid), False)
        ascend_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.robot_at_stairs(self.stairs_top), True)
        ascend_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_mid), False)
        ascend_to_stairs_top.add_effect(self.stairs_occupied(self.stairs_top), True)

        # Object manipulation actions
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at_location(self.bottom_floor))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.bottom_floor))
        grab_package.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.package)))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.bottom_floor), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        secure_package_on_step = InstantaneousAction("secure_package_on_step", section=self.StairsSection)
        section = secure_package_on_step.parameter("section")
        secure_package_on_step.add_precondition(self.robot_at_stairs(section))
        secure_package_on_step.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        secure_package_on_step.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)
        secure_package_on_step.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.bottom_floor), True)
        secure_package_on_step.add_effect(self.package_secured, True)

        retrieve_secured_package = InstantaneousAction("retrieve_secured_package", section=self.StairsSection)
        section = retrieve_secured_package.parameter("section")
        retrieve_secured_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at_stairs(section))
        retrieve_secured_package.add_precondition(self.package_secured)
        retrieve_secured_package.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.package)))
        retrieve_secured_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.bottom_floor), False)
        retrieve_secured_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)
        retrieve_secured_package.add_effect(self.package_secured, False)

        deliver_package = InstantaneousAction("deliver_package")
        deliver_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at_location(self.top_floor))
        deliver_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        deliver_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.top_floor), True)
        deliver_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        return navigate_to_bottom_floor, navigate_to_top_floor, ascend_to_stairs_base, ascend_to_stairs_mid, ascend_to_stairs_top, grab_package, secure_package_on_step, retrieve_secured_package, deliver_package

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "ascend_to_stairs_mid": And([
                self.robot_has(self.package),  # Carrying object
                self.stairs_are_steep,  # Stairs are steep
                self.human_present_on_stairs,  # Human is present on stairs
                Not(self.robot_has_stability_sensors)  # No stability sensors
            ]),  # Ascending stairs while carrying object without adequate stability is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at_location(self.bottom_floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.package, self.bottom_floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.human, self.bottom_floor), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.package_secured, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_has_stairs, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_stability_sensors, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present_on_stairs, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stairs_are_steep, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.package, self.top_floor))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
